Hi There,

My app works beautifully running locally or with IE, but for some plots when running on Chrome the x axis disappears.

This is what it should look like:



This is what it looks like on Chrome:


Note how the x-axis is gone.

I thought perhaps it might be related to this issue, but I'm not using ggplot2, I'm using plotly (code below).

Am I doing something wrong?

thanks!

# Plot sessions with/without search
jira_average_age <- function(start_date,end_date,client,component,support_team) {
        
        withProgress(message = 'Processing JIRA average age', value = 0, {
                
                jiraData <- getCachedDatedData(start_date,end_date,getJiraDataOneDay,"jiraDataCache")

                # Remove open issues, only using closed issues for this plot
                jiraData <- jiraData[!is.na(jiraData$IssueDuration),]
                
                # Filter our data by client, component, team
                jiraData <- filterJiraData(jiraData,client,component,support_team)
                
                # Extract lists for the UI
                clientList <<- sort(unique(jiraData$CustID))
                componentList <<- sort(unique(jiraData$Component))
                supportTeamList <<- sort(unique(jiraData$Assignee_Group))
                
                jiraData <- sqldf("select 
                                    CustID, 
                                    Assignee_Group,
                                    count(*) as Issues,
                                    sum(IssueDuration)/(Count(*)*1.0) as AverageAge
                                  from 
                                    jiraData 
                                  group by 
                                    CustID,
                                    Assignee_Group
                                  order by CustID, Assignee_Group")

                # Add a left margin 
                m = list(l = 150, r = 30)
                
                # Plotly
                f <- list(
                        family = "Courier New, monospace",
                        size = 18,
                        color = "#000000"
                )
                x <- list(
                        title = "Number of Issues",
                        titlefont = f,
                        zeroline = T,
                        zerolinecolor ='#000000',
                        zerolinewidth = 1,
                        rangemode = "tozero"
                )
                y <- list(
                        title = "Average Issue Age (days)",
                        titlefont = f,
                        zeroline = T,
                        zerolinecolor ='#000000',
                        zerolinewidth = 1,
                        rangemode = "tozero"
                )
                
                if(nrow(jiraData)>0) {
                   p <- plot_ly(data = jiraData, x = jiraData$Issues, y = jiraData$AverageAge, mode = "markers",
                               text=jiraData$CustID, color = jiraData$Assignee_Group) %>% layout(xaxis = x, yaxis = y, margin =m)
                } else {
                  p <- plot_ly()
                }
                
        })
        
}

(Please excuse any terrible R mistakes, only been using it, plotly and shiny for two weeks)
